programs.desc: The loggers of the Pacific Northwest perform what is said to be North America’s most dangerous job. Watch as the men react to news of upcoming layoffs. Gustafson Logging tries to get back on track, Browning Logging races to meet a big deadline and Pihl Logging needs to finish the Pig Farm Job. Despite Melvin’s best efforts to keep up with his old equipment, Stump Branch Logging loses one of its most important machines.
